snippet.title: Jumu'ah Ki Woh Ghari Jab Dua Qubool Hoti Hai | Sahih Bukhari 935 #shorts
snippet.description:
Jumu'ah ke din ek aisa waqt hai, jo sab se qeemti hai.

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ»
"Jumu'ah mein ek ghari hai. Jo Muslim banda us ghari mein namaz parhte hue Allah se koi bhalai maange, Allah use zaroor ata farmata hai." Aur aap ne haath se ishara farmaya ke woh ghari bohat thori si hai.

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 935: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:935

Woh ghari chhupi hui hai, is liye aaj sara din dua maangte rahein, aur apne walidain ke liye dua zaroor karein. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
